Name: StardewTuber
Author: Maiya0126
Description:
[b]StardewTuber[/b]
[b]Become a livestreamer in Stardew Valley! Every day in Pelican Town is a stream day![/b]
Ever wondered what it would be like to farm, fish, mine, and make friends while thousands of viewers watch your every move? Picture this: a chat window on the right side of your screen, filled with scrolling messages cheering you on, cracking jokes, and hyping up big moments.
[b]StardewTuber[/b] brings a fully immersive livestream chat system to Stardew Valley. Every day feels like you're streaming to a live audience!
[heading]Core Features[/heading]
Chat System
Real-time livestream chat window with dynamic stream titles that change with season, weather, and in-game events
30+ unique preset viewers, each with their own personality: Farmer Qiang, Miner Liu, Fisherman Hai, Artisan Xiao Yi, Ancient Fruit Fanatic Lao Zhou, Junimo Enthusiast Xiao Green, the "Just a Random Viewer" who never misses a stream, Emoji Spammer, Ocean Fishing Fanatic Big Fish, River Fishing Lover Xiao Zhou, and many more
Viewer rank system: viewers automatically rank up based on message count and tips — Captain, Commander, Governor
You can chat too! Press Enter to open the input box, type a message, and join the conversation
Adjustable chat density, message lifetime, max on-screen messages, font size, and window opacity
Bilingual chat templates (English and Chinese), auto-detected from game language
AI Chat (Player2 Recommended)
Player2 desktop app: just open it, no API Key, no Endpoint, no model name needed — auto-connects and works instantly
Also supports Gemini / OpenAI / DeepSeek / Grok / GLM / OpenRouter / SiliconFlow and more
AI is aware of game context: season, weather, time of day, gold, inventory items, online viewers, stream heat, subscriber count — generating relevant chat messages for the moment
Async request with message buffer: AI messages appear 2-3 at a time every few seconds, saving tokens and feeling natural
Three chat modes: Local Templates Only / Local+AI Mixed / AI Priority
Stream Ecosystem
Heat system dynamically affects online viewer count — more heat means more viewers and more tips
Game event integration: legendary fish, prismatic shards, skill level-ups, festivals, animal births, bundle completions, crop harvests — all trigger chat hype and heat spikes
Stream titles auto-switch based on season, weather, and luck — Spring Thunderstorm Indoor Stream, Summer Storm Rainy Chat, Autumn Drizzle Harvest Season, Winter Blizzard Cozy Fireplace Stream, and more
Daily stream earnings: gold and subscribers are calculated when you end the stream; subscribers accumulate but decay 3% each day
Viewer pool system: preset characters + randomly generated viewers, each with their own message weight and favor
More Interactive Features
Tip system: Small Tips (20-100g) / Medium Tips (200-500g + gem items) / Large Tips (800-2000g + rare items like Prismatic Shards, Iridium Bars, Stardrops) — tipped items go straight to your inventory
Spam mode: major events trigger chat explosions, the stream erupts with excitement
Live status bar showing real-time viewer count, subscriber count, and heat percentage
15 chat template categories: Praise, Mock, Tease, Exclaim, Spam, Greeting, Cheer, Fishing, Mining, Farming, Animals, Events, Romance, Community, Casino
[heading]Easy to Use[/heading]
One-click stream toggle button on the right side of the screen — green = LIVE, gray = OFFLINE
Full GMCM (Generic Mod Config Menu) support — all settings adjustable in-game
Auto-start stream option — begin streaming automatically when you load your save
Console commands: /st_toggle, /st_status, /st_heat, /st_spam, /st_listviewers, /st_p2detect
Data persists across saves: subscribers and lifetime earnings follow your save file
[heading]Quick Start[/heading]
Load your save → Click the "LIVE" button on the right → The chat window appears → Play Stardew Valley normally (farm / fish / mine / socialize) → In-game events trigger chat hype automatically → Viewers send tips and gifts → End the stream to collect gold and subscriber earnings.
Highly recommended to use with the Player2 desktop app. Just open it and AI chat works automatically — no setup needed. If you prefer not to use AI, the local template chat is already rich and varied!
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Does not affect vanilla saves / Does not block game interactions / Can be disabled anytime / Window position and opacity are fully adjustable
[heading]Support[/heading]
中文 / English
